description: This file defines a Flutter widget named PlayerCard, which displays a mini profile of a cricket player including an avatar, name, jersey number, role, and stats such as runs and wickets. It imports other project-specific modules like Player model and app theme.

classes.name: PlayerCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a player's profile card with avatar, name, role, and stats.

methods.name: PlayerCard
methods.description: Constructor for the PlayerCard widget, requiring a Player object and an optional onTap callback.

methods.name: initials
methods.description: Getter that computes initials from the player's name, used in the avatar.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the player card, including avatar, name, role, and stats layout.

methods.name: _stat
methods.description: Helper method to display individual statistic label and value.

methods.name: _roleLabel
methods.description: Helper method to convert PlayerRole enum to display string.
